sentences.en: She looked at me with a supercilious expression when I asked for help.
sentences.zh: 当我请求帮助时，她用一种傲慢的表情看着我。

sentences.en: The manager was supercilious towards the new employee, making him feel unwelcome.
sentences.zh: 经理对新员工态度高傲，让他感到不受欢迎。

sentences.en: His supercilious manner made everyone uncomfortable at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在会议上的那种傲慢举止让每个人都感到不舒服。
